verdict.rationale: Founder Law is a founder-focused immigration and corporate law firm whose offerings are attorney-managed packages and consultations. An online legal service could conceivably expose a public API, so the axis applies, but the evidence documents none. Probes of standard OpenAPI/Swagger paths all returned 404, and an llms.txt file is not an API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
